description: Dictionary entries for a Chinese word, a pinyin syllable or a Vietnamese word: simplified and traditional forms, pinyin, Hán Việt per character (Thiều Chửu), Vietnamese senses (CVDICT), English senses (CC-CEDICT), HSK level. Every field carries `src`, the source it came from. `kinds` says how the query was read and each entry's `match` which reading found it. `vi: null` means CVDICT has no Vietnamese for that word: say so, don't translate the English as if it were the dictionary's. No entries means the word isn't in the dictionary: say so, don't guess.

by.description: Force how q is read. Leave out to let the server tell hanzi, pinyin and Vietnamese apart.

q.description: Chinese characters (觉得, 覺得), pinyin with or without tones (jué de, jue2 de5, jue de) or Vietnamese (cảm thấy).

name: lookup
title: Look up a Chinese word
